Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE individual square high-resolution finished children's picture-book illustration, not a contact sheet or grid. This is a single page of Six Sleeps Until Cousin Hugs for age four. Reference 1 is appearance only: Abba left adult, Miri middle girl, Mama right adult, Avi infant. Reference 2 is appearance only: Uncle Lior left man, Aunt Taylor second woman, Levi tall older teenage boy, Matan younger shorter school-age boy. Reference 3 Spaceship art is STYLE INSPIRATION ONLY: carry over its enchanting violet/blue/gold palette, round expressive storybook characters, warm faces, imaginative scale, and beautiful tactile paper atmosphere, but render this book primarily in DREAMY LUMINOUS WATERCOLOR with soft pigment blooms, delicate pencil contours, glowing light, and subtle handmade-paper texture. Reference 4 clarifies Avi is a very young BABY, never a walking toddler. Miri is FOUR, blonde hair in two braids, BOTH UPPER FRONT TEETH MISSING with a clear small gap when smiling. Miri's outfit for dream adventures: lavender long-sleeve top with tiny golden stars, blue leggings, pink shoes. Levi visibly taller/older than Matan: short wavy brown hair, teal sweatshirt, navy pants. Matan short dark hair, ochre sweatshirt, charcoal trousers. Ayla is another young girl around Miri's age with a dark-brown ponytail, rose/coral clothes. Avi always safely supported, swaddled or carried, in RAINBOW clothes/blanket; never participating in older children's physical activities. Abba swept wavy light-brown hair, short beard; Mama brown tied-back hair. Lior short dark upswept hair, clean-shaven; Taylor long dark wavy hair. Preserve recognizable faces as watercolor illustrations, not pasted photographic faces. Dream pages get misty lilac edges, tiny warm sparkles and imaginative atmosphere, but the main scene must remain readable. Avoid extreme photorealism, hard vector fills, garish neon, generic dark-haired substitute Miri, extra limbs, random text, letters, watermarks, logos, speech balloons, page borders or numbers. No text at all; the website supplies words separately.
SCENE: FRONT COVER ART. Miri in her cozy bed in the lower half, smiling with her front-tooth gap, her father Abba beside the bed. Above and around them, one flowing dream cloud features her older taller cousin Levi and younger cousin Matan reaching out for a hug, with dark-ponytailed Ayla and tiny rainbow-swaddled infant Avi safely cradled in Mama's arms nearby. Soft ribbons of bay water with a tiny ferry, redwood silhouettes, a little blue bike and gold crowns are background dream motifs, not separate panels. Warm golden bedside light blends into enchanting lilac and indigo dream sky. Keep topmost 25% relatively calm pale lavender for website title overlay, key faces in middle/lower region. Big readable expressive faces, loving anticipation.
referenceRoles: Existing Avi book Spaceship art for mood and palette
